newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 11 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 11 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 11 issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Boulder, Colo., $10.820 million water and sewer improvement revenue bonds.
--Chatham County, N.C., $5.435 million GOs and $14 million GOs.
--Hannibal CSD, N.Y., $3.3 million school district bonds.
--Lehigh County Authority, Pa., $1.705 million sewer revenue bonds.
--Tennessee School Board, Tenn., $4.380 million, $4.025 million, $55.455 million and $101.465 million educ. fac. revenue bonds.
